answer_1.quote: The model can access these tools by generating one or more tool calls as code (usually JSON) which conforms to the API specification. ... In the second step, the model generates a text response to the user based on the tool call result
answer_1.outputs: Tool calls in JSON format or natural language responses (direct answers, follow-up questions, 'unable to answer')

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy, (byte-)length-normalized accuracy and F1 metrics. ... We define tool hallucination to occur when the model chooses the tool call answer even though no tool specifications were provided

answer_3.quote: We implement a second, alternative LLM-as-judge metric. ... We then use an LLM-as-judge, specifically GPT-4-Turbo-04-09, to classify the target LM's generated output into the four multiple-choice categories: direct answer, tool call, followup question and unable to answer.
